name: BSP_GeomMeshResourceParser_GetName
evidence: Previously missing function; exact 007258f0-00725910. ECX parser unused; stack hidden native-string output; EAX same output, RET4. Constructs output through 0041e870 from literal 00cfdbcc (GeomMesh). Original ABI: ECX parser is unused; one stack hidden-result native-string pointer. Calls 0041e870 with ECX output and literal stack argument, returns same output pointer in EAX, RET4.. Evidence: docs/GAME_RESOURCE_PARSER_REGISTRATION.md; reports/game_resource_parser_registration_audit.json. Descriptive name is a hypothesis; no native ABI or gameplay validation.

name: BSP_Gun_NextReadyBarrel
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(ECX = gun)(int start) -> int, RET 4, body read in full 007298D0-0072990x. Scans forward from start modulo gun[448h] over the reload timers at gun[414h] for the first barrel whose timer is at or below zero (comiss against a zeroed XMM0 at 007298F1, jae). With a non-positive barrel count, or when no barrel is ready, 00729904 returns the caller's unreduced argument in EBX. docs/UNIT_WEAPON_DEVICES.md.

name: BSP_UnitInstance_LastDamageStateIndex
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. int __fastcall(unit), body 0072AB10-0072AB4F. Reads unit+360h, the 1ACh part instance built by 007135C0, and returns ((inst+170h - inst+16Ch) >> 4) - 1 when that 10h-stride vector is non-empty, else 0. Its single caller BSP_UnitInstance_ReactToHealthChange 00958A30 passes the result to vtable+1B4h at 00958ADC and 00958C11 when a sub-object breaks, and 0 when it is repaired, so the value is the last damage-state index of the part instance. docs/UNIT_PARTS.md.

name: BSP_Gun_DebugDumpFields
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Body 0072ADC0-0072B2C1. Prints the gun device's fields: for each it pushes a {type, value} pair and then a {0, name-pointer} pair and calls a formatter virtual, so the literal string names the field read just before it. This is the source of the field names barrelNum (gun+448h, 0072B283), nextFireBarrel (+44Ch), contFiring (+454h), delayGroupCnt (+444h), delayGroupIndex (+440h), delayGroupSize (+43Ch), barrelDelayTime (+450h), throwA (+400h), throwB (+404h), and of the per-barrel record at gun+3D4h with stride 14h (add ebp,14h at 0072B051) holding dist at +4h, speed at +8h and DT at +Ch. docs/UNIT_WEAPON_DEVICES.md.

name: BSP_Gun_SetBarrelReloadTimer
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(ECX = gun)(int barrel, float time, int setFull), RET 0Ch at 0072D01D and 0072D127. Writes gun[414h][barrel] = time and, when setFull, gun[418h][barrel] too. Below the threshold float 00D7A278 the value is first divided by 1.0f (00D7A24C) or by 008E6430(8, gun+3F0h) when 00E0C978 and (00F88C30)+E8h are set, which is why the no-ammo sentinel 00CFDBF8 never decays. The effect-attach tail after the write is unread. docs/UNIT_WEAPON_DEVICES.md.

name: BSP_Gun_RearmBarrel
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(ECX = gun)(int barrel, char full), RET 8. Asks gun[3F0h]->vtable[1F4h](gun+3F4h) for a round; on failure writes the sentinel 00CFDBF8 into the barrel timer through 0072CF00, otherwise consumes through vtable[1F8h] and, when full, re-arms with a random reload drawn by 00BD2F10 from gun[3F8h]+28h..+2Ch. Argument shape read at 0072D555 and 0072D57E against the RET 8. docs/UNIT_WEAPON_DEVICES.md.

name: BSP_Gun_SetupFromDescriptor
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(ECX = gun), body 0072E6D0-0072F053, RET. The producer of the gun's barrel layout: writes barrelNum at 0072E71A, nextFireBarrel at 0072E72A, delayGroupSize and barrelDelayTime at 0072E8DB, sizing the device from its weapon descriptor. Only those writes were read; the rest of the body is unread. docs/UNIT_WEAPON_DEVICES.md.
